verdict.rationale: Namecheap clearly has an XML API and a Go SDK, but none of the evidence shows an endpoint or feed that returns per-TLD registration, renewal or transfer prices. GetTldList returns TLDs and their API capabilities, not prices, and the Create/Renew calls are only described as charge-bearing actions. The axis applies to a registrar, so the lack of evidence for a pricing endpoint makes this none rather than na.
